scope: Only force_fused opt-in to exact all-F32 Sink B1/H64or128/KVheads1/D512/arraymask/sinks/Q>8 schema, selected by Hyle only on known Apple generations13-16. Ordinary, unknown/new architecture defaults, NAX/page/other dtype/vector branches remain unchanged.

native.resource: The fixed SDK header and embedded JIT source already contain compact zero-padding. Existing float template instantiated; no shader/metallib/SDK rebuild or precision reduction.
native.sink_semantics: Existing kernel initializes max from raw sink and sum=1, adds F32 global additive mask to logits, keeps F32 exp probabilities/PV, normalizes only by sink+keys. Finite sink plus all -Inf key masks contributes zero weighted value.
native.unknown_limits: No D512 ordinary/decode/training/CPU/other GPU support. Controls cover moderate fixed scale and finite sinks, not all finite F32 values. Source has scale and sink pre-multiplication by log2(e), which may overflow for extreme finite values before zero/masked logits; this potential boundary was not experimentally tested and cannot be claimed equivalent over the full public F32 value range.

source_and_build.source: Hyle baseline is current canonical source; fast.cpp baseline SHA matches current manifest. Candidate Metal selector uses current D192 materialized host projection. Original SDK native baseline predates unrelated !mask&&!sinks ordinary D192/D256 host selector edits; those do not affect this Sink domain.

matched_latency.processes: Exactly four sequential independent processes. Two untimed warm invocations, one full independent FP64 oracle before and one after, nine timed complete submit-to-checked-wait samples each. All36 durations and8 complete-oracle outcomes retained.
matched_latency.boundary: Same one consumer TU and fixed inputs. Input creation, prepare/isolated warmup/JIT, invocation creation/bind, two warm invocations, oracle checks, lease/result destruction, final Context drain/destruction all outside sample timing. Each sample includes real public submit and successful checked Completion wait. ResultLease and OwnedResult destroyed before slot reuse. No cache clearing or retuning between timed samples.
matched_latency.native_change: Only removed cstdio/fprintf diagnostics from measured host source, retained actual PSO<=device guard; compiled one fresh native host TU plus the shared timing consumer. Other candidate TUs and SDK reused. Original PSO/raw space source and observations preserved separately.
